# Receipt

A payment receipt with line items, tax, total and a link to the full invoice.

- **Subject:** `Your Acme receipt #{{receipt_number}}`
- **Live preview:** [groundmail.github.io/email-templates/#receipt](https://groundmail.github.io/email-templates/#receipt)

| File | What it is |
|------|------------|
| [`receipt.tsx`](receipt.tsx) | React Email component. Props are typed; preview with `npm run dev`. |
| [`receipt.mjml`](receipt.mjml) | MJML source. Compiles on its own with `npx mjml`. |
| [`receipt.html`](receipt.html) | Ready-to-send HTML with `{{variable}}` placeholders. |
| [`receipt.txt`](receipt.txt) | Plain-text version with the same placeholders. |
| [`groundmail.json`](groundmail.json) | Template payload for the Groundmail templates API. |

## Variables

| Placeholder | React prop | Example |
|-------------|------------|---------|
| `{{name}}` | `name` | Ada |
| `{{receipt_number}}` | `receiptNumber` | 2041-7730 |
| `{{paid_at}}` | `paidAt` | October 16, 2026 |
| `{{payment_method}}` | `paymentMethod` | Visa ending in 4242 |
| `{{item_description}}` | `items[].description` | Pro plan (monthly) |
| `{{item_amount}}` | `items[].amount` | $40.00 |
| `{{subtotal}}` | `subtotal` | $50.00 |
| `{{tax}}` | `tax` | $4.13 |
| `{{total}}` | `total` | $54.13 |
| `{{receipt_url}}` | `receiptUrl` | https://example.com/billing/invoices/2041-7730 |

The HTML, MJML and hosted versions have one line item (`{{item_description}}`, `{{item_amount}}`). For several items, render the React component in your app (it takes an `items` array) or repeat the row in the MJML.

## Create it in your Groundmail account

Each command creates (or updates) a template with the alias `receipt` and publishes it. Get an API key with the `templates:write` scope at [app.groundmail.dev](https://app.groundmail.dev/signup).

**From a clone**

```bash
# 1. Edit theme.ts (name, logo, colors), then:
npm install
export GROUNDMAIL_API_KEY=gm_your_key_here
npm run push -- receipt
```

**CLI**

```bash
npx -y --package=groundmail-cli -- groundmail templates push templates/receipt/receipt.html \
  --alias receipt \
  --name "Receipt" \
  --subject "Your Acme receipt #{{receipt_number}}" \
  --text templates/receipt/receipt.txt \
  --publish
```

**No clone (API)**

```bash
# Creates the template with the default theme, then publishes it.
curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Groundmail/email-templates/main/templates/receipt/groundmail.json \
  | curl -X POST https://api.groundmail.dev/templates \
      -H "Authorization: Bearer $GROUNDMAIL_API_KEY" \
      -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
      --data-binary @-

curl -X POST https://api.groundmail.dev/templates/receipt \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $GROUNDMAIL_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"action":"publish"}'
```

## Send it with Groundmail

Once the template is in your account, send it by alias and pass the variables. The React Email example skips the hosted template and renders the component at send time.

### Node.js

```bash
npm install groundmail
```

```tsx
import { Groundmail } from 'groundmail'

const groundmail = new Groundmail(process.env.GROUNDMAIL_API_KEY!)

await groundmail.emails.send({
  from: 'Acme <noreply@yourdomain.com>',
  to: 'ada@example.com',
  template: {
    id: 'receipt',
    variables: {
      name: 'Ada',
      receipt_number: '2041-7730',
      paid_at: 'October 16, 2026',
      payment_method: 'Visa ending in 4242',
      item_description: 'Pro plan (monthly)',
      item_amount: '$40.00',
      subtotal: '$50.00',
      tax: '$4.13',
      total: '$54.13',
      receipt_url: 'https://example.com/billing/invoices/2041-7730',
    },
  },
})
```

### React Email

```bash
npm install groundmail @react-email/render react
```

```tsx
import { Groundmail } from 'groundmail'
import Receipt from './templates/receipt/receipt'

const groundmail = new Groundmail(process.env.GROUNDMAIL_API_KEY!)

// Renders the component with @react-email/render, then sends the HTML.
await groundmail.emails.send({
  from: 'Acme <noreply@yourdomain.com>',
  to: 'ada@example.com',
  subject: 'Your Acme receipt #2041-7730',
  react: (
    <Receipt
      name="Ada"
      receiptNumber="2041-7730"
      paidAt="October 16, 2026"
      paymentMethod="Visa ending in 4242"
      items={[{description: "Pro plan (monthly)", amount: "$40.00"}, {description: "Extra seats × 2", amount: "$10.00"}]}
      subtotal="$50.00"
      tax="$4.13"
      total="$54.13"
      receiptUrl="https://example.com/billing/invoices/2041-7730"
    />
  ),
})
```

### Python

```bash
pip install groundmail
```

```python
import os
from groundmail import Groundmail

groundmail = Groundmail(os.environ["GROUNDMAIL_API_KEY"])

groundmail.emails.send(
    from_="Acme <noreply@yourdomain.com>",
    to="ada@example.com",
    template={
        "id": "receipt",
        "variables": {
            "name": "Ada",
            "receipt_number": "2041-7730",
            "paid_at": "October 16, 2026",
            "payment_method": "Visa ending in 4242",
            "item_description": "Pro plan (monthly)",
            "item_amount": "$40.00",
            "subtotal": "$50.00",
            "tax": "$4.13",
            "total": "$54.13",
            "receipt_url": "https://example.com/billing/invoices/2041-7730",
        },
    },
)
```

---

Using another provider? The `.html` and `.txt` files use plain `{{variable}}` placeholders, which Handlebars, Mustache, Liquid-style engines and most email APIs accept as-is.
